moves.name: one-right
moves.why: A column moved two places right: the columns it passes shift left one.

moves.name: one-left
moves.why: A column moved three places left: the columns it passes shift right one.

moves.name: block-right
moves.why: A block of two moved right: `to` is the block's first place in the order after the move, among the rest.

moves.name: to-the-end
moves.why: The first column moved to the last place.

moves.name: to-its-own-place
moves.why: A block moved to where it is changes nothing: no move.

moves.name: to-past-the-end
moves.why: `to` past the columns less the block's length (6 − 2 = 4): no move.

moves.name: block-past-the-columns
moves.why: A block reaching past the last column: no move.

moves.name: into-the-run
moves.why: Count 2; a scrolled column moved to place 1, inside the run: it pins, the count up by one.

moves.name: out-of-the-run
moves.why: Count 3; the first column moved to place 4, among the scrolled: it unpins, the count down by one. The run's other columns (r = 2) stay pinned.

moves.name: within-the-run
moves.why: Count 3; a pinned column moved within the run (to 2, the run's end r = 2, on its own side: it was pinned): the count kept.

moves.name: within-the-scrolled
moves.why: Count 2; a scrolled column moved among the scrolled: the count kept.

moves.name: run-end-first-columns-side
moves.why: Count 2; a scrolled column moved to place 2, the run's end (r = 2), by `move_columns`: it keeps its first column's side, scrolled, the count kept.

moves.name: run-end-pinned
moves.why: As run-end-first-columns-side, by `move_columns_pinned` with the pinned side: it joins the run at its end, the count 3.

moves.name: run-end-scrolled
moves.why: Count 2; the first column moved to place 1, the run's end (r = 1), on the scrolled side: it unpins as the first scrolled column, the count 1.

moves.name: pin-in-place
moves.why: Count 2; the first scrolled column (place 2) moved to its own place on the pinned side: the order kept, the count 3. A move that only pins.

moves.name: unpin-in-place
moves.why: Count 2; the last pinned column (place 1) moved to its own place on the scrolled side: the order kept, the count 1.

moves.name: other-side-refused
moves.why: Count 2; `to` 1 is inside the run (r = 2), but the side given is scrolled: no move.

moves.name: count-past-the-columns-kept
moves.why: Count 9 over 6 columns; a move with every column pinned before and after: nothing crossed, so the host's count is kept as it was, past the columns.

moves.name: count-past-the-columns-crossing
moves.why: Count 9 over 6 columns; the first column moved to the run's end (r = 5) on the scrolled side: one left the run, a change on the count clamped to the columns, 6 − 1.

moves.name: straddling-block-in
moves.why: Count 3; a block of places 2 (pinned) and 3 (scrolled) moved to place 0: it lands pinned, the scrolled one joining, the count 4.

moves.name: straddling-block-out
moves.why: Count 3; the same block moved to place 4: it lands scrolled, the pinned one leaving, the count 2.

moves.name: selection-moves-with-its-block
moves.why: A `columns` range of the block moved follows it: Google Sheets' gesture leaves the block selected at its new places.

moves.name: selection-outside-kept
moves.why: A `cells` range right of the places a move shifts is as it was.

moves.name: selection-shifted
moves.why: A `cells` range inside the places a move shifts (2..3, the column from 4 put at 1) shifts right by the block's length, its rows kept.

moves.name: selection-holding-block-and-shifted
moves.why: A `columns` range holding the block and every place it shifts holds the same places after.

moves.name: selection-split-cleared
moves.why: A range whose columns are no longer side by side (place 2 moved out of 1..2) is cleared.

moves.name: selection-direction-kept
moves.why: A `cells` range whose anchor is right of its head keeps it so: the anchor at the run's right end, the head at its left.

moves.name: rows-kept
moves.why: A `rows` range is kept, its cells' columns as they were.

controls.name: count-kept
controls.why: A move across pin's edge leaves the count as it was: the block pins or unpins nothing.

controls.name: recount
controls.why: The count recounted from the columns (clamped, then changed by what crossed) even when nothing crossed: a host's count past the columns is lost.

controls.name: selection-unmoved
controls.why: The selection left at its places: it selects the columns now there.
